definitions: A surname from French, equivalent to English Taylor or Snyder.

blocks.text: André Joseph Ghislain Parmentier, also known as Andrew Parmentier is one of a generation of American landscape designers who arrived from Europe in the early years after Independence. Many of these designers, including William Russell Birch and George Isham Parkyns, also practiced landscape depiction, reinforcing the picturesque connection of landscape art as both making and representing places.

André Parmentier was a French sport shooter who competed at the 1908 Summer Olympics and at the 1920 Summer Olympics. He was born in Sauveterre de Guyenne, Gironde. In 1908, he was a member of the French team, winning the bronze medal in the team free rifle competition. He also finished fourth with the French team in the team military rifle event.
